AboutSection.title: About Me
AboutSection.description: DevOps engineer with 2+ years delivering and operating containerized workloads across managed cloud and self-managed Linux. I operate the Kubernetes and Helm deployment of a production LLM-backed service across four environments, own a multi-tenant AWS platform built from 22 reusable Terraform modules, and build delivery pipelines in Jenkins, GitLab CI and GitHub Actions. I also support development and release teams through build and deployment failures, and write the runbooks they follow.

ExperienceSection.title: Work Journey
ExperienceSection.description: Owning infrastructure and delivery pipelines for client products.

bullets: Primary DevOps and infrastructure engineer across three concurrent client products: own the infrastructure and delivery pipelines of a multi-tenant clinic-booking platform, and support releases and environments for Kotae (AI chatbot) and StarLive (real-time streaming) in teams of 14–15.

Built and maintained delivery pipelines across three CI systems: Jenkins (Jenkinsfile pipelines for container build and publishing behind test and quality gates, plus administration of agents, credentials and plugins), GitLab CI and GitHub Actions.

Restructured an internal HR platform's GitHub Actions CI into reusable workflow_call components gated on lint and type-check, replacing a workflow_run setup that silently skipped every pull request's first run.

Closed the gap between local, CI and production by replacing MinIO with LocalStack so tests hit the same S3 API as the deployed service, and enforced commit and pull-request conventions as an automated gate.

Wrote Bash automation for deployment, migration and environment provisioning, served as first-line support on build and deployment failures from pipeline and container logs to root cause, and wrote the runbooks used to onboard new client environments.
Built Gitman, an internal Git repository management tool, from the first commit to a company-wide release as the sole developer.
Moved onto client product work at the end of the internship and was promoted to Software Engineer after six months.

portfolio.title: Portfolio Platform on Amazon EKS
portfolio.summary: This site, run as a production platform: Amazon EKS behind Cloudflare, built and operated across three repositories for the app, the Terraform infrastructure and the Argo CD GitOps configuration.
bullets: Containerized the app with a multi-stage Dockerfile (non-root user, health check) and built arm64 images for a Graviton node.

Defined the AWS and Cloudflare stack in Terraform: VPC, a one-node EKS cluster with a private API endpoint, ECR, SSM Parameter Store and EKS Pod Identity, with the Cloudflare proxy in front of an ALB that accepts traffic from Cloudflare only.
Ran the cluster as GitOps with Argo CD ApplicationSets and Helm charts: AWS Load Balancer Controller, External Secrets, HPA autoscaling, and Prometheus with remote write to Grafana Cloud dashboards.

Automated releases with GitHub Actions: an arm64 image pushed to Amazon ECR through OIDC with no long-lived keys, an approved image tag committed to the GitOps repo, a smoke test and an automatic revert on failure.
Kept the run within a fixed AWS credit budget: a scheduled Lambda scales the node to zero at night and on Sundays, backed by AWS Budgets and CloudWatch alarms by email.

ercBooking.title: ERC Booking — Infrastructure & CI/CD
ercBooking.summary: Clinic scheduling platform built for per-tenant isolation; sole owner of its infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
bullets: Owned the Terraform codebase end to end: 151 resources across 22 reusable modules (VPC, ECS Fargate, Aurora PostgreSQL, ElastiCache, CloudFront + WAF, SQS, SES, Backup, Bastion).
Designed the per-tenant isolation model so each new clinic gets a dedicated production environment from the same modules, then stood up the first production tenant alongside shared dev and staging.

Built the GitHub Actions rollout pipeline that patches ECS task definitions, registers revisions and rolls out API and worker services with stability checks, old-revision cleanup and path-based selective builds.
Engineered a branch-gated Liquibase migration pipeline that runs as a one-off ECS Fargate task per environment and links straight to CloudWatch Logs for failure triage.
Authored the S3 + CloudFront release pipeline for the frontend, with immutable cache-control on hashed assets and targeted invalidation for zero-downtime deploys.

kotae.title: Kotae — AI Chatbot Platform
kotae.summary: Production AI workload serving 10+ SME customers, with RAG retrieval and generation backed by AWS Bedrock, OpenAI and Gemini, operated on Kubernetes across four environments.
bullets: Operated the Helm-managed Kubernetes deployment across four isolated environments (development, test, demo, production): release rollouts and rollbacks through Helm against per-environment values, autoscaling and ingress configuration.

Kept memory-heavy, bursty AI workloads stable under live traffic: diagnosed OOMKilled containers, CrashLoopBackOff and failing probes with kubectl, and tuned resource requests, limits and probe thresholds.
Hardened the RAG ingestion path against server-side request forgery with private-IP and redirect checks around the crawler, covered by unit tests.
Contributed Terraform for the service's Cognito and S3 resources, and unblocked developers when builds and rollouts failed on the shared multi-environment pipeline.
